limitations: Chronological intervals are not matched strategy or economic comparisons.
Audit signatures/history are bounded and do not establish full source completeness.
No natural exposure means no forward holding-protection or realized P&L evidence.
Initial full registry states are not serialized in result; ready-backlog reconstruction is explicitly a lower bound.
No later price or unavailable information is backdated into decisions.
No market request, credential access, financial writer, counter mutation, production change or trading occurred in this reduction.
